key.name: effect-enabled
key.description: Toggle the dynamic velocity-based cursor scaling effect on or off.

key.name: min-move-scale
key.description: Scale multiplier as soon as the mouse starts moving slowly (1.0 = normal cursor size).

key.name: max-fast-scale
key.description: Maximum scale multiplier when moving the mouse fast.

key.name: max-speed-threshold
key.description: Pointer velocity (in pixels per second) at which the cursor reaches its maximum size.

key.name: grow-smoothing
key.description: How quickly the cursor expands when speed increases (0.05 to 1.0).

key.name: shrink-smoothing
key.description: How quickly the cursor shrinks back to normal size when slowing down or stopping (0.03 to 0.5).

key.name: hide-system-cursor
key.description: Hide the native hardware cursor while the scaled cursor is visible.

key.name: fire-breathing-enabled
key.description: Animate a breathing halo of light around the mouse pointer to locate it faster.

key.name: fire-breathing-always
key.description: Keep the breathing halo pulsing around the pointer even when the mouse is parked.

key.name: fire-breathing-size
key.description: Base diameter of the breathing halo of light around the pointer.

key.name: fire-breathing-intensity
key.description: Opacity and glow intensity of the breathing halo (0.15 to 1.0).

key.name: fire-breathing-speed
key.description: How fast the halo of light breathes in and out.

key.name: comet-fire-enabled
key.description: Animate a comet-fire trail behind the moving mouse pointer to show its trajectory.

key.name: comet-fire-length
key.description: Number of flame particles in the comet trail (6 to 28).

key.name: comet-fire-size
key.description: Diameter of the comet-fire head right behind the pointer.

key.name: comet-fire-duration
key.description: How long the comet tail lingers before burning out (0.10 to 0.80 seconds).

key.name: fire-theme
key.description: Color palette for Fire-Breathing Halo and Comet-Fire Trail (ember, solar, plasma, emerald, crimson).

key.name: click-effect-enabled
key.description: Show an expanding shockwave ripple at the exact screen location where you click (ideal for screen recording).

key.name: click-color-by-button
key.description: Use distinct ring colors for Left Click (Gold/Orange), Right Click (Cyan/Blue), and Middle Click (Emerald/Green).

key.name: click-effect-size
key.description: Maximum expanded diameter of the click ripple shockwave (36 to 180 px).

key.name: click-effect-duration
key.description: How long each click ripple animation lasts (0.18 to 1.00 seconds).

key.name: click-effect-intensity
key.description: Peak opacity of the click shockwave ring (0.20 to 1.00).
